'''Nighthowl Alphas''' are worgen found in [[Gilneas]].

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Nighthowl Shackle]] for {{questlong|Alliance|43|Nighthowl Nuisance}}.
* Must be killed for {{questlong|Alliance|43|Nighthowl Neutralizing}}.
* Drops [[Nighthowl Pelt]] for {{questlong|Horde|40|Ebonmere Worgen Infestation}}.
* Drops [[Worgen Blood Vial]] for {{questlong|Horde|43|We Take It From The Living}}.
